note: TrumpRx prices are cash prices. Cash-pay only, does NOT count toward deductible or out-of-pocket max. Some drugs exclude Medicare/Medicaid patients. Generic prices are the lowest listed price and vary by strength and quantity.

mycophenolate.note: Generic mycophenolate mofetil (CellCept), lowest listed price. Mycophenolic acid (Myfortic) is a different product — check which one you take

sirolimus.note: Generic tablets, lowest listed price; oral solution from $42.08. Don't switch forms without your transplant team

cyclosporine.note: Modified (Neoral/Gengraf generic) from $12.50; non-modified (Sandimmune) from $35.48 — the two are NOT interchangeable

everolimus.note: Generic tablets (Zortress), lowest listed price — varies by strength and quantity

vfend.note: Serious fungal infections in immunocompromised patients

solumedrol.note: Medrol (oral methylprednisolone), used in rejection treatment

protonix.note: Generic pantoprazole is ~$30 on GoodRx, check generic first!

farxiga.note: Diabetes + kidney & heart protection, increasingly used post-transplant

liothyronine.note: Cytomel, thyroid issues can develop post-transplant
